news.title: New Mould Workshop Put into Operation
news.descr: A dedicated mould-making area now handles electrode machining, EDM and fit-out under one roof.
news.descr_zh: 独立模具车间投入使用，电极加工、放电与配模在同一个车间内完成。
news.content:
Mould workshop

Our new mould workshop is now running, covering CNC machining, EDM, wire cutting and fit-out in one area.

  1. 3 CNC machining centres
  2. 4 EDM machines and 2 wire-cut machines
  3. Mould trial press for T1 samples
Shorter tooling lead time and faster engineering changes.
ItemCapacity
Mould lead time12-20 days
Mould life300,000 shots
news.content_zh:
模具车间

新的模具车间已投入运行，CNC 加工、放电、线切割与配模集中在同一区域完成。

  1. 3 台 CNC 加工中心
  2. 4 台火花机、2 台线切割
  3. 配试模压机，用于 T1 试模
模具交期更短，工程更改响应更快。
项目能力
模具交期12-20 天
模具寿命30 万模次

news.title: Injection Capacity Expanded to 16 Machines
news.title_zh: 注塑产能扩充至 16 台机
news.descr: Tonnage now spans 50T to 250T, covering thin-wall parts and thick-wall cosmetic jars.
news.descr_zh: 锁模力覆盖 50T 至 250T，兼顾薄壁件与厚壁膏霜瓶。
news.content:
We have added injection machines so the workshop now runs 16 machines from 50T to 250T, all with robot take-out.

  • Thin-wall parts from 0.9mm
  • Thick-wall cosmetic jars up to 3mm
  • Two-colour and over-moulding capability
news.content_zh:
新增注塑机后，车间现有 16 台 50T-250T 注塑机，全部配机械手取件。

  • 最薄可做 0.9mm 薄壁件
  • 最厚可做 3mm 厚壁膏霜瓶
  • 具备双色与包胶成型能力

news.title: ISO 9001 Quality System Re-certified
news.title_zh: ISO 9001 质量体系复审通过
news.descr: The annual audit closed with zero major non-conformities.
news.descr_zh: 年度审核完成，无重大不符合项。
news.content:
ISO 9001 quality management system re-certified for the coming cycle.

The audit covered incoming material control, process inspection and final inspection, and closed with no major non-conformities.

  • Incoming material: RoHS reports on file
  • In-process: first-article and hourly patrol inspection
  • Final: AQL sampling before shipment
news.content_zh:
ISO 9001 质量管理体系复审通过，有效期延续至下一周期。

本次审核覆盖来料管控、制程检验与出货检验，未产生重大不符合项。

  • 来料：留存 RoHS 检测报告
  • 制程：首件确认 + 每小时巡检
  • 出货：按 AQL 抽检

news.title: New Powder Puff Case Tooling Delivered
news.descr: Living-hinge tooling delivered with a 200,000-cycle hinge test report.
news.descr_zh: 活动铰链模具交付，并附 20 万次开合测试报告。
news.content:
A new powder puff case tool was delivered to a cosmetics customer together with a hinge fatigue test report.

hinge_test: 200000 cycles
snap_force: 8-12 N
colour: Pantone 705C

The tool runs a 1 mould 2 cavities layout with a hot runner system.
news.content_zh:
新款 粉扑盒 模具已交付化妆品客户，并附带铰链疲劳测试报告。

铰链测试: 20 万次
扣合力: 8-12 N
颜色: Pantone 705C

模具采用 1 模 2 穴排位，配热流道系统。
